lines.t: (Verse 1 – rap)
Yeah, I been running from the Voice in the silence,
Yeah, I been running from the Voice in the silence,
Heart cold, but Your love still violent,
Infinite, burning like a riot in the sky,
Every time I drift, I can feel You cry.
You say, “Child, I’m undone when you leave,”
My choices cut deep, make Your heart bleed,
I was busy chasing flesh, chasing dopamine,
Didn’t see the brokenness behind the holy King.
You were watching every tear that I never let fall,
Counting all the days till I answer Your call,
“I accept your bruises, your scars, your fight,”
Still I blocked You from filling me with life.(Pre‑Hook – melodic)
You hold infinite love, I keep pushing You away,
Yet You’re counting down the seconds till I turn and stay,
I can hear You whisper to my shame and fear,
“Let Me in, let Me in, I’ve been right here.”(Hook – melodic/pop)
Tear me down in Your love, I don’t want this guard no more,
I’ve been breaking Your heart every time I close that door,
You’re undone when I run, I can’t fake it,
My soul aches ’cause I know that You take it.
I’ve been blocking all the light, You’re enough, I confess,
I just wanna be destroyed in the fire of Your chest,
If Your love never ends, I don’t wanna stand apart,
So I’m laying every sin on the floor of Your heart.(Verse 2 – rap)
Yeah, lust in my veins, pride in my talk,
Flexing like a giant but I’m hollow in the walk,
You say, “Stop taking part in the pleasures of the world,”
Still I kept dancing with the demons that swirled.
I was fearless in the flesh, but a coward in the Spirit,
When You cried out my name, I pretended not to hear it,
But Your jealousy burns like a raging flame,
’Cause You paid with blood just to call my name.
“I’m in love with you, will you love Me too?”
Every bar that I spit is an answer to You,
I’m done choosing death, I’ve been playing that part,
Now I wanna be the song that is healing Your heart.(Pre‑Hook – melodic)
You hold infinite love, I keep pushing You away,
Yet You’re counting down the seconds till I turn and stay,
I can hear You whisper to my shame and fear,
“Let Me in, let Me in, I’ve been right here.”(Hook – melodic/pop)
Tear me down in Your love, I don’t want this guard no more,
I’ve been breaking Your heart every time I close that door,
You’re undone when I run, I can’t fake it,
My soul aches ’cause I know that You take it.
I’ve been blocking all the light, You’re enough, I confess,
I just wanna be destroyed in the fire of Your chest,
If Your love never ends, I don’t wanna stand apart,
So I’m laying every sin on the floor of Your heart.(Bridge – soft melodic)
If every step away cuts You deep inside,
Then every “yes” I give becomes holy pride,
So I lay down my crown, my will, my fight,
Take it all, light me up in Your endless light.(Outro – melodic + ad‑libs)
Infinite love, won’t abandon me,
Even when I run, You’re still calling me,
“I’m enough,” that’s the anthem of my soul tonight,
Destroy me in Your love, bring me into Your light.
Destroy me in Your love, bring me into Your light.
